WORDS.intro: The town is planning another meeting about the farm, here at the library. Last time, the meeting was at 2 pm, upstairs, and only in English. Five chairs stayed empty. Who was missing? Help everyone join.
WORDS.instr: Tap an empty chair to see who is missing.
WORDS.shown: Here is a way that helps.
WORDS.confirm: Some chairs are still empty. Finish anyway?
WORDS.aha: A meeting at 2 pm, upstairs and only in English leaves people out: nurses who sleep in the day, kids in school, families who speak Spanish. Small changes can bring everyone in.
WORDS.can: I can notice who is missing and help them join.

$parts: Next time, open every empty chair.
is missing, then pick a way that fixes that.

WORDS.tip100: Great job! Everyone can join. Try a new round.
WORDS.real: Think of someone who doesn't usually get asked, at school or at home. With a grown-up, find a way to ask what they think.
WORDS.guText: Kids notice who is missing from a meeting and match a way to include them: evening times, interpreters, a ride, a ramp, a recording, a kids' corner. At real hearings, interpreters and written comments let more people take part.

bank.b0002: An interpreter and a Spanish flyer
bank.b0003: A kids' corner and a question box
bank.b0006: A ramp and a ground-floor room
bank.b0007: Ms. Lee works nights at the clinic. At 2 pm, she is asleep.
bank.b0008: Look for a way that works while she is awake.
bank.b0010: Lucía's mom and dad speak Spanish best. The flyer and the meeting were only in English.
bank.b0011: Look for a way to share the meeting in Spanish.
bank.b0012: Jayden is in class at 2 pm. And nobody asked students what they think.
bank.b0013: Look for a time after school, or a way for students to share.
bank.b0014: It's harvest time. Mr. Johnson works in his fields until late every night.
bank.b0015: Look for a way that works any time he is free.
bank.b0016: Grandma Ruth doesn't drive anymore, and no bus goes to the library.
bank.b0017: Look for a way to get her there.
bank.b0019: Theo uses a wheelchair. The meeting room was upstairs, with no elevator.
bank.b0020: Look for a way in without stairs.
bank.b0021: Mr. Patel can't close the bakery in the middle of the day.
bank.b0022: Look for a way that works after the bakery closes.
bank.b0023: Mrs. Ana has two little kids and no babysitter.
bank.b0024: Look for a way to bring her kids, or to join after bedtime.
